name: TEMP.Veles
summary: TEMP.Veles is a Russia-based threat group that has targeted critical infrastructure. The group has been observed utilizing TRITON, a malware framework designed to manipulate industrial safety systems.

procedures.text: TEMP.Veles utilizes watering hole websites to target industrial employees.
TEMP.Veles targeted several ICS vendors and manufacturers.
